output:
I'll start by reading the docs and the package layout.

Applying the fixes now. The first batch is in `parse.py`.

I fixed the bugs in `patchkit`, and all 46 unit tests now pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). `tools/check.py --data data` reports 0 broken cases for every rule. A full `run` over `data` still refuses 8 of the 150 cases. I read the error for each of the four cases I opened (036, 082, 117, 120) and found no sign the package was wrong.

I also checked the code against the docs for cases the tests don't cover. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

What I changed under `/app/patchkit`:

- **`parse.py`:**
  - The trailing carriage return is now stripped from every patch line.
  - Header paths now end at the first tab, so spaces stay in the path.
  - A range with no count now means a count of 1. It was wrongly 0.
  - Several end-of-file markers after the last hunk line are accepted.
  - Reversing a patch now swaps the old-side and new-side markers.
- **`search.py`:**
  - Every fuzz level is now tried over all candidate positions before the next level.
  - When two positions are equally far from the expected one, the lower line is tried first.
  - A hunk can no longer apply before the end of the previous applied hunk.
- **`apply.py`:**
  - The expected position of a hunk with an empty old range is now right after line `A`.
  - Offsets are reported from the stated line, with no carried offset subtracted.
  - Added lines take the file's ending.
  - Context lines keep the file's own ending.
- **`report.py`:** file entries now follow patch order instead of path order. The `moved` count now includes only hunks with a non-zero offset.

I did not touch `/app/tests`, `/app/data` or `/app/docs`. `git` isn't installed here, so I couldn't produce a diff.

I left one case unchanged because the docs don't settle it. For a hunk made only of context lines, fuzz currently drops lines from the start but not from the end.

command_result.command: cd /app && find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat docs/overview.md && wc -l patchkit/*.py docs/*
cd /app && cat docs/cases.md docs/patch.md docs/paths.md docs/lines.md docs/apply.md docs/output.md docs/changelog.md; ls docs/archive tools data | head -20
cd /app && for f in patchkit/*.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat -A $f | sed 's/\$$//' ; done
cd /app && cat docs/lines.md; head -12 docs/apply.md; cat patchkit/lines.py
cd /app && cat -n patchkit/parse.py | head -110; cat docs/archive/*; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /app && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='patchkit/parse.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    lines = text.split("\\n")
    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
        lines.pop()
    return lines''','''    lines = text.split("\\n")
    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
        lines.pop()
    return [ln[:-1] if ln.endswith("\\r") else ln for ln in lines]''')
s=s.replace('re.split(r"\\s", rest, maxsplit=1)[0]','rest.split("\\t", 1)[0]')
s=s.replace('a, b = int(m[1]), int(m[2]) if m[2] is not None else 0','a, b = int(m[1]), (int(m[2]) if m[2] is not None else 1)')
s=s.replace('c, d = int(m[3]), int(m[4]) if m[4] is not None else 0','c, d = int(m[3]), (int(m[4]) if m[4] is not None else 1)')
s=s.replace('''    if i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("\\\\") and h.lines:
        _mark(h.lines[-1])
        i += 1''','''    while i < len(lines) and lines[i].startswith("\\\\") and h.lines:
        _mark(h.lines[-1])
        i += 1''')
s=s.replace('HunkLine(flip[hl.kind], hl.text, hl.old_eol, hl.new_eol)','HunkLine(flip[hl.kind], hl.text, hl.new_eol, hl.old_eol)')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='patchkit/search.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('(abs(p - expected), -p)','(abs(p - expected), p)')
s=s.replace('def locate(h: Hunk, lines: list[Line], start: int, fuzz: int)','def locate(h: Hunk, lines: list[Line], start: int, fuzz: int, floor: int = 0)')
s=s.replace('candidates(start + top, 0, len(lines) - n)','candidates(start + top, floor, len(lines) - n)')
s=s.replace('    tries.sort(key=lambda t: (t[1], t[0]))\n','')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='patchkit/apply.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('    return h.old_start - 1','    return h.old_start if h.old_len == 0 else h.old_start - 1')
s=s.replace('out.append((text, end if hl.new_eol else ""))','out.append((text, end))')
s=s.replace('out.append((hl.text, "\\n" if hl.new_eol else ""))','out.append((hl.text, ending if hl.new_eol else ""))')
s=s.replace('expected_start(h) + carry, fuzz)','expected_start(h) + carry, fuzz, cursor)')
s=s.replace('    carry = 0\n','    carry = 0\n    cursor = 0\n')
s=s.replace('"offset": line - stated - carry','"offset": line - stated')
s=s.replace('        carry = line - stated\n','        carry = line - stated\n        cursor = m.pos + n\n')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='patchkit/report.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('    entries.sort(key=lambda e: e["path"])\n','')
s=s.replace('h["offset"] != 0 or h["fuzz"] > 0','h["offset"] != 0')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git diff --stat; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /app && sed -n 28,55p patchkit/apply.py; grep -n 'floor\|sort' patchkit/search.py; grep -n 'rest.split\|else 1\|ln\[:-1\]\|while i < len' patchkit/parse.py; python tools/check.py data 2>&1 | tail -20
cd /app && python tools/check.py --data data 2>&1 | tail -20; ls data/cases | wc -l; python -m patchkit run --out /tmp/o && python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('/tmp/o/errors.json')))"

cd /app && python - <<'EOF'
import json
for c in ['036','082','117','120']:
    d=json.load(open(f'data/cases/case-{c}.json'))
    print(c, d.get('options')); print(repr(d['patch'][:1500])); print()
EOF

cd /app && cat > STATUS.json <<'EOF'
{"status": "success", "summary": "Fixed patchkit bugs against the docs: CR stripping in patch lines, tab-terminated paths, default hunk count of 1, reverse swapping of EOF markers, empty-range expected position, fuzz-level-first search order, lower-first tie-breaking, no overlap or reordering of hunks, offsets from the stated line, added-line endings, patch-order file entries and the summary 'moved' count. All unit tests pass and tools/check.py reports no broken cases."}
EOF
python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3
